# Getting help

Tellerwerk has no company, no hosted service and no support team behind it. It's an open-source project that one person looks after in their spare time. There is no account to recover and no server that holds your data: everything is on your device.

## First, check the README

Most questions are answered there:

- **Installing:** [Install on your phone](../README.md#install-on-your-phone): web app, Android APK, iPhone with SideStore.
- **Coming from the old app:** [Moving from OpenPlate](../README.md#moving-from-openplate).
- **A feature works on one platform but not another:** [Differences between platforms](../README.md#differences-between-platforms).
- **The AI photo feature:** [Set up the AI photo feature](../README.md#set-up-the-ai-photo-feature).
- **What leaves your device:** [Privacy and security](../README.md#privacy-and-security), or in the app under Profile → *Your data*.

## Your data

Your data only exists on your device, so nobody can restore it for you. Export a backup from time to time (Profile → *Export data*) and keep it somewhere safe. If backup encryption is on and you forget the password, nobody can open the file, the maintainer included.

To move to a new phone or browser, export on the old one and use Profile → *Import data* on the new one. Your AI key, your Open Food Facts login, the app lock and the offline product pack are not in the backup; set them up again.

## Asking

- **Something doesn't work:** [open a bug report](https://github.com/uivox/Tellerwerk/issues/new?template=bug.yml). Include the platform, the version and the steps.
- **Wrong food values:** [report them](https://github.com/uivox/Tellerwerk/issues/new?template=food-data.yml). For products with a barcode, correcting them on Open Food Facts helps everyone.
- **An idea:** [suggest it](https://github.com/uivox/Tellerwerk/issues/new?template=idea.yml).
- **A security problem:** report it [privately](https://github.com/uivox/Tellerwerk/security/advisories/new), never in a public issue.

Answers usually take a few days. Issues are public, so never post diary data, API keys or passwords there.

## Not covered

Tellerwerk isn't a medical service. For questions about your health, your diet or an eating disorder, please talk to a doctor or a registered dietitian.
